_: Growize sandbox access configuration (D120 draft). Derived from docs/ACCESS-PLAN.md §1-§5, D78, D80, D110, D115-2, zoho/field-register.json, CLAUDE.md rule 7. Module perms: v=view c=create e=edit d=delete; a module not listed = no access. Field values: hidden | read_only | read_write. Every choice the plan does not state is listed under provisional and in docs/decisions/D120-sandbox-access-config-draft.md.

moduleVisibility._: Modules the sandbox shows in the UI. Applied 8-9 Oct 2026: Tasks, Calls and Events (Meetings) went from user_hidden to visible, so the IR, IR Manager and Channel Partner permissions below are usable. The planner reads GET /settings/modules and emits a MANUAL step when a status is not 'visible' (the update call is not recorded; see zoho/changes/2026-10-08-09-sandbox.md).

general._: Per-module permissions matched by name prefix Crm_Implied_<prefix>_ (live probe 5 Oct 2026: Standard has Export, Import, Mass Delete/Transfer/Update, Change Owner, Share, Merge, Delete Mail on for most modules). View All / Edit All bypass sharing and stay off everywhere. Export off for all (rule 7). Share (D121 A, owner ruling 5 Oct 2026; D122: KAM access is Zoho-native, no sharing user): on only for IR Manager and Digital Infrastructure (manual override for cover windows and fixes), and only on Contacts, LLP_UnitAllocation_Module and Touches ('modules'); off everywhere else.

profiles.name: Leadership
profiles.description: BU owner: reads everything except money modules (ACCESS-PLAN 3); plans and tasks.

profiles.name: Digital Infrastructure
profiles.description: D110: non-administrator super user. Every page of both sides; no money writes (ACCESS-PLAN 5); identity read for logged reveals. D121 A: manual Share on Contacts/allotments/Touches.

profiles.name: IR Manager
profiles.description: IR team lead: team's leads via the role tree, own investors read-only by record share. D121 A: views allotments (Share needs View) and holds manual Share on Contacts/allotments/Touches; allotment money stays hidden. Receipts View+Create since 8 Oct 2026 (pending P-RECEIPTS-IR).

profiles.name: IR
profiles.description: Investor Relations: own leads; own investors and their allotments read-only by Zoho field sharing (Contacts.Originating_IR, allotments IR_Access; D123); identity and money hidden (rule 7). Receipts View+Create only since 8 Oct 2026 (sandbox test finding); this does not meet the D69 reading 'IR never reads receipts', owner to confirm before live (pending P-RECEIPTS-IR).

profiles.name: Finance Head
profiles.description: Head of Finance: money, payouts, farm release fields; reversals.

profiles.name: Finance Ops
profiles.description: Finance Operations: records and matches money, bank details, payouts.

profiles.name: Compliance and Audit
profiles.description: Reads everything, passes or fails KYC, sees PAN; no money writes. Named without '&' to match the D80 role.

profiles.name: AM Head
profiles.description: Head of AM: investors, allotments (no money fields), tickets, updates.

profiles.name: KAM
profiles.description: KAM: own investors and allotments by record share; identity and money hidden. Leads view only (W3-KAM-1): Leads stay private, the KAM reads only its investors' origin leads through Leads.KAM_Access (read-only user-lookup sharing), so a Touch filed on the origin lead is accepted. Leads View applied 8 Oct 2026 (no create/edit/delete); the Leads.KAM_Access sharing that makes it useful is still pending (P-KAM-ACCESS).

profiles.name: Channel Partner
profiles.description: Partner: own leads only. No investor, money or identity access.

profiles.name: Integration
profiles.description: Service profile: creates Cases only (ACCESS-PLAN 1). Identity hidden (rule 7).

fieldSecurity._: Every profile listed under profiles gets a value for every field below: its entry in 'grant', else 'default'. Administrator is never touched (it ignores FLS anyway).

groups.source: ACCESS-PLAN 3 row 2; field-register Contacts.pan (writer compliance); rule 7; KYC and KYC_Completed_On moved to group kyc_status on 8 Oct 2026
8 Oct 2026 sandbox change: Finance Ops sees the KYC outcome (read-only); identity numbers and proofs stay in group identity. Same grants as identity plus Finance Ops read_only
ACCESS-PLAN 3 row 4 (Amount_n/UTR_n/Date_n do not exist in the sandbox)
D123 Q2: IR sees its own investors' allotments without price or yield (D69 projection, now also in Zoho field security)

defaultSharing._: Verify only (D80 applied these). Values per GET /crm/v8/settings/data_sharing share_type.

sharingRules._: Record_Owner_Based: records owned by CEO and every role under it (= every user) shared to one role, no subordinates, superiors not allowed. Names are the idempotency key. D121 A: 'roleManual' rules name a role that may not exist yet; the planner emits a manual step to create it instead of failing.

provisional: P1 Module permissions where ACCESS-PLAN is silent follow least privilege; no non-admin profile gets Delete on any module (corrections go through edit or an administrator).

P2 Digital Infrastructure reads bank and identity fields (read_only) so the D68/D110 logged reveals work on Sahil's own token; it never writes them. ACCESS-PLAN 3 predates D110. Flip grant to hidden if the owner reads D110 otherwise.
P3 Bank fields: Finance Ops writes, Finance Head reads (field-register: one writer, 'finance'). Identity: Compliance and Audit writes, Finance Head reads.
P4 Aadhaar_Last4 hidden from IR/KAM per ACCESS-PLAN 3; field-register lists them as readers - the plan wins (stricter), register to be reconciled.
P5 Leadership and Viewer get no Receipts/Investor_Payouts and money fields hidden (ACCESS-PLAN 3 'hidden from every profile except Finance').
P6 Investor_Payouts treated like Receipts (Finance writes, Compliance reads, sharing rules to Finance roles).
P7 Token_Advance_Amount added to allotment money; Receipts Mode/Kind/Received_On/Match_State/Matched_By/Reversal_Of hidden with Amount/UTR.

P8 Lead_Events create/edit for IR, IR Manager and Digital Infrastructure. D115-2 (event-sheet load = super administrator only among Digital Infrastructure) cannot be expressed per user in a Zoho profile; it stays a console seat right (CONSOLE_SUPER_ADMIN_IDS).
P9 Integration gets Cases view+create only (Zoho pairs create with view); no Contacts access - if the Case-to-Contact lookup needs it, add Contacts view; identity stays hidden either way.
P10 Compliance and Audit also gets read sharing rules on Leads, Touches, Cases ('reads everything', D80).
P11 Mass update on for heads only; import only for Digital Infrastructure; export and mass delete off for every created profile.

P14 D121 A: IR Manager gets View on LLP_UnitAllocation_Module because Zoho enables Share only under View (parent permission); allotment money fields stay hidden and records are visible only where shared or owned below in the role tree.

P15 D123 Q2: IR gets View on LLP_UnitAllocation_Module so Zoho field sharing (IR_Access, read-only) can show an IR its own investors' allotments; the old record share gave nothing because IR had no allotment permission. Money stays hidden; Unit_Price and Annual_Rental_Yield are hidden from IR only (group allotment_price_ir); Contacts identity stays hidden; IR never reads Receipts (D69).

P16 D123 Q1/Q3 (NOT expressible in this spec, owner applies in Zoho): Leads.Secondary_Owner field sharing OFF; Leads.Cover_By sharing read-write; Contacts.Originating_IR sharing read-only; new LLP_UnitAllocation_Module.IR_Access (userlookup, sharing read-only, read-only for every profile except Administrator). See docs/decisions/D123-field-sharing-cover-handoff.md.

P17 8-9 Oct 2026 sandbox changes captured: Events vce for IR, IR Manager, Channel Partner; Receipts vc for IR and IR Manager; ARL_Holdings/ARL_Transactions View for Finance Ops, Finance Head, Compliance and Audit, Digital Infrastructure; KYC read-only for Finance Ops (group kyc_status). Receipts for IR contradicts the D69 reading in P15: owner to confirm before live. Listing Events and ARL_* under modules makes plan() switch those permissions off for every profile not listed; if the sandbox gave other profiles access through the Standard clone, plan() shows the difference.
